## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Adhikaraṇavāra* (Pvr 2.14) is an analytical section belonging to the *Parivāra*, the fifth and concluding treatise of the Theravāda *Vinayapiṭaka* [SuttaCentral]. As its title indicates, the text analyzes the monastic disciplinary rules by relating each offense to the four classes of legal issues or procedures (*adhikaraṇa*) recognised in monastic law [SuttaCentral]. Modern translations cataloged by SuttaCentral include an English rendering by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].
No direct external parallels in Chinese or Tibetan canonical collections are recorded for this text [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. None of the sampled secondary literature passages specifically treat this subsection of the *Parivāra*.
